name: Takeru Sato
method: Read-only public Kaggle About and Competitions pages in the Claude app's built-in browser on 2026-10-30, one tab, waiting between loads, no refresh loops. Page text, the page's own image alt labels and a screenshot of the competition list were used to read the medal icons. The joined date was read from the page's hover tooltip and the profile image address from the visible profile image element. The public ARC board JSON on arc.markbarney.net and the GitHub profile page linked from the Kaggle profile were fetched with plain read-only requests, not the browser. An older draft of this file was not reused.

facts.text: TK256 is a Kaggle Competitions Expert with three silver medals and one bronze medal on his own profile, and the profile dates the account to June 2025.
facts.sourceTitle: TK256 - public Kaggle profile, tier, medals and join date

facts.text: Kaggle lists his NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge entry 62nd of 4,185 with silver and his ROGII Wellbore Geology Prediction entry 225th of 6,125 with silver, and shows only his account on each. It also lists his Orbit Wars entry 393rd of 4,729 with bronze, again showing only his account.

The 2026 NeuroGolf Championship entry finished 55th of 2,963 with silver, and Kaggle shows four accounts on it: akihirokkkkk, k256net, tk256ailab and ktajpn. That silver is a shared entry medal, not his alone.
facts.sourceTitle: TK256 - NeuroGolf entry and listed accounts on Kaggle

facts.text: His account is one of eight shown on the active ARC-AGI-3 entry, and the public ARC board lists that team, named 復活の混テキスト, 10th of 4,984 on October 30, 2026. That is a provisional public standing, not a medal, until the competition closes.
facts.sourceTitle: ARC-AGI-3 public board snapshot, team 復活の混テキスト (provisional)

facts.text: His Kaggle profile links to the GitHub account tk256ailab, whose profile is titled Takeru Sato | TK256 and describes him as part of the Tohoku NLP Group and an aspiring AI engineer.
facts.sourceTitle: tk256ailab (Takeru Sato | TK256) - GitHub profile linked from Kaggle

teamNotes: Kaggle's competition list never prints a team name, only avatar labels, so every teamName in completedResults is null rather than guessed.
NeuroGolf shows four accounts (akihirokkkkk, k256net, tk256ailab, ktajpn). The silver belongs to that entry as a group and must not be written as his individual honour.

ARC-AGI-3: Kaggle's active card shows eight avatar labels (yuto0712, ttyn4519, pompom555, isakatsuyoshi, tanakaai24, refv00, tk256ailab, konbu17). The team name 復活の混テキスト and its rank come from the public board at arc.markbarney.net, not from the Kaggle pages, and the board's member list matches those eight handles.
The Nemotron, ROGII and Orbit Wars medals are on entries where Kaggle displays only his own account, so they can be credited to him as the displayed account holder.
unverified: The name Takeru Sato does not appear on the Kaggle pages, which show the display name TK256. It rests on the GitHub profile title linked from his Kaggle page. The face is not visible in the profile photo, so the photo does not confirm the name.

The public ARC-AGI-2 board lists a team named TK256 with only the handle tk256ailab, 871st of 3,535 with a score recorded for 2026-08-30, but ARC-AGI-2 is not on his Kaggle competitions list. Treated as an unconfirmed roster observation and not used as a fact.
Exact completion dates are not shown, only relative labels such as 3 months ago.
The ARC-AGI-3 standing is provisional and will change before the competition closes. No medal is implied.
Kaggle's printed Activity counts (11 solo, 2 in a team) do not reconcile with the 10 listed competitions and are not used.
